Hi all,

Quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk: when pet bookings come in, keep the handoff clean, calm, and customer-first. Passengers like Yara Bianchi and Andre Larsen should hear the same simple guidance every time, with no guesswork and no mixed messages. If a family is traveling with Stella or another animal, our job is to reduce stress, confirm the basic travel steps, and make sure the support around the trip feels steady from start to finish.

<<FACT F051>> We should keep our replies brisk, warm, and practical. Lead with what the traveler needs to do next, then follow with any required service notes in plain language. If there is confusion at check-in, stay focused on the passenger's concern and avoid pushing the issue around. Every animal deserves patient attention from trained staff, and that standard should show up in every call, message, and desk interaction. When we are clear and kind, we help the traveler feel like Aurelia Skyways is on their side.

Please keep flagging anything that looks incomplete or off track so we can fix it before it reaches the passenger. A small correction early is always better than a bigger problem later. Thanks for staying sharp and keeping the experience smooth for both travelers and their pets. This team makes a real difference when we stay consistent and helpful.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
